description: A "/reviews/" or "/decisions/" segment marks a peer-review or editorial object (e.g. 10.7287/peerj.10325v0.1/reviews/2), not the study (issue #17). These records echo the reviewed paper's title verbatim, so every replication phrase in the title fires on something that is not the paper.

measured.rationale: A DOI path segment minted by the publisher for the review object itself; the mapping is structural, not statistical.
